bio: This restaurant strives to ensure that what you eat leaves an impression. No-nonsense preparations place the ingredients front and centre and the menu oozes luxury, with French ingredients such as caviar, foie gras and truffles. Counter-style service conveys the message of each dish directly to diners in their own language. True to its name, meaning ‘empathy’ in French, the restaurant creates in chef and diner a shared anticipation of each coming season....
